titulo: Burnham pledges UK's full support to Ukraine in first meeting with Zelenskyy since becoming prime minister
cuerpo: Zelenskyy's visit was the first by a foreign leader since Andy Burnham took office a week ago, succeeding Keir Starmer. The newly-appointed prime minister said it underscored the London's continued unwavering support for Kyiv as it defends itself against Russia's full-scale invasion.
